note: Case manifest for tests/proof-harness/capture.mjs. Every seed entry names its kind explicitly: 'engine_seed' = state this driver launches live through the plugin door (zero-token graphs; one real assistant turn for the card echo); 'historical_snapshot' = a pinned, already-committed run/session fixture read via the door's legacy-launch-root fallback (read-only, never relaunched). Adding a case ADDS A NEW TEST: a case naming a surface outside surfaces_registry fails exit 3 ('new test, not implemented') — the driver never fabricates an existing command. Baseline never captures synthesis/index.html or any file-openable RC: surfaces come from the real app renderer only.

baseline.description: Real-app proof of the three live surfaces of the actual React/SDK renderer: the ::workflow directive card in the message stream, the WORKFLOWS pane (run list + held-gate run detail), and the settings-gated live-run tray row. All state is engine-seeded into an isolated test runs root; nothing here is a CHATFRAME reconstruction.

coverage.description: bd_2026-11-13-yjp full-census fetch frames on the REAL renderer: >1 page fixture census seeded THROUGH the read model (seed_fixture.py; rows read 'interrupted' — never TERMINAL — so the pane's own 4 s poll loop drives the frames). Frames: loading (every /runs page stalled via CDP Fetch), empty census answered (roots named), full census (133 counted rows all loaded), deepest counted row rendered past the first 100 + its record page opened, refetch-failure with cached census kept (stale chip), retry re-walk (census grew to 134 while the edge failed; chip gone, no loaded-suffix), partial fetch (page-2 fulfill short: 'loaded 100 of 134' shown honestly while the summary stays global), cap truncation disclosed (every page a full synthetic window WITHOUT any total — the walk clips at the 30-page cap and the pane shows 'first 100 loaded — more exist (page cap)': the truncated fact rides the payload, never inferred from a missing number), pending (counted 237 / loaded 0 renders 'Runs pending…' with counted-vs-loaded facts, never the 'No runs' costume — reviewed F4), and pending recovery (trusted click on the re-walk button returns the real all-loaded census).
